title: 2001 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 1
statement: A circle of radius 3 crosses the center of a square of side length 2 . Find the difference between the areas of the nonoverlapping portions of the figures.

solutions.text: Call the area of the square \(s\), the area of the circle \(c\), and the area of the overlapping portion \(x\). The area of the circle not overlapped by the square is \(c-x\) and the are of the square not overlapped by the circle is \(s-x\), so the difference between these two is \((c-x)-(s-x)=c-s=9 \pi^{2}-4\).
